summary: @ornikar/webpack-config 12.0.11 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated math_init.js payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style code that at install time downloads the Bun v1.3.13 runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into a temporary directory, extracts and chmods the `bun` binary executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], {cwd: D})`. math_init.js is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated bundle (obfuscator.io shape: `// @bun @bun-cjs` banner, rotating string-array decoder, hex-named globals, ~1000-entry constant table), is not referenced by the package's declared `index.js`, and has no relation to the advertised webpack-configuration purpose of the package. The alternate-runtime hop (Bun) is used to execute the opaque payload out-of-band from Node so Node-based install-time scanners do not observe the payload's runtime behavior. Every `npm install` of this version auto-executes math_init.js under the freshly dropped Bun binary before any user code runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
